item.title: Best Cafes & Brunch in Balaclava 2026
item.description:
Updated 18 March 2026 | Food Editor

Best Cafes & Brunch in Balaclava 2026

Balaclava’s cafe scene has evolved into one of Melbourne’s most exciting culinary destinations. This inner-suburb, with its rich Jewish heritage and multicultural influences, offers a diverse range of breakfast and brunch experiences that go well beyond the typical smashed avo on toast. From traditional Eastern European bakeries to innovative modern cafes, Balaclava serves up something for every palate.

item.title: Best Cafes & Brunch in Collingwood 2026
item.description:
Updated 18 March 2026 | Food Editor

Best Cafes & Brunch in Collingwood 2026

Collingwood’s cafe scene continues to evolve, blending the suburb’s industrial heritage with Melbourne’s ever-innovative coffee culture. From heritage-listed warehouses to converted factories, these are the spots defining breakfast and brunch in this creative pocket of Melbourne’s inner north.

Venue Addresses & Details

  • Proud Mary Coffee — 172 Oxford St, Collingwood VIC 3066 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7am-4pm, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm. Tip: Try the filter coffee flight to experience their rotating single origins.
  • Terror Twilight — 11-13 Johnston St, Collingwood VIC 3066 ($$). Open: Mon-Sun 8am-4pm. Tip: The breakfast ramen is a cult favorite that sells out early on weekends.
  • Allpress Espresso — 89 Rupert St, Collingwood VIC 3066 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7am-4pm, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm. Tip: Grab a seat at the communal table to watch the roastery in action.
  • Archie’s All Day — 189 Gertrude St, Fitzroy/Collingwood border VIC 3065 ($$). Open: Mon-Sun 8am-4pm. Tip: The ricotta hotcakes are legendary; perfect for sharing.
  • Plug Nickel — 104-106 Smith St, Collingwood VIC 3066 ($). Open: Mon-Fri 7am-3pm, Sat-Sun 8am-3pm. Tip: Perfect for a quick takeaway coffee before walking down Smith Street.

Admiral Cheng-Ho

325 Johnston Street, Collingwood VIC 3066

item.title: Best Cafes & Brunch in Prahran 2026
item.description:
Updated 18 March 2026 | Food Editor

Best Cafes & Brunch in Prahran 2026

Prahran’s cafe scene continues to evolve in 2026, with innovative brunch spots and beloved institutions serving everything from classic smashed avo to boundary-pushing culinary creations. Here’s where to find Melbourne’s most exciting morning meals in this inner-city suburb.

1. The Bottom End, Prahran VIC 3181

A Prahran institution that’s been reimagined for 2026, The Bottom End has transformed from its pub origins into a sophisticated all-day dining destination. Their brunch menu features raise the standardd classics like truffle scrambled eggs with Yarra Valley caviar and their signature buttermilk hotcakes with seasonal berries and house-made honeycomb. The sprawling outdoor terrace is perfect for Melbourne’s warmer months.

item.title: Best Cafes & Brunch in South Yarra 2026
item.description:
Updated 18 March 2026 | Food Editor

Best Cafes & Brunch in South Yarra 2026

South Yarra’s cafe scene continues to evolve in 2026, with innovative newcomers joining beloved institutions to create one of Melbourne’s most dynamic breakfast destinations. From heritage-listed buildings housing third-wave coffee roasters to experimental brunch spots pushing culinary boundaries, this stylish suburb offers something for every palate and preference.

Venue Addresses & Details

  • Two Birds One Stone — 12 Claremont St, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Tip: The corn fritters are a local staple; arrive before 10 AM on weekends to avoid the queue.
  • Abacus Bar & Kitchen — 383 Chapel St, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Mon-Sun 7:30 AM - 10:00 PM. Tip: Perfect for a long brunch that transitions seamlessly into afternoon cocktails.
  • Darling Cafe — 265 Punt Rd, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM. Tip: Try the signature hot cakes; they are highly Instagrammable and generous in portion size.
  • Lawson Grove Shop — 1 Lawson Grove, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM, Sat 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Tip: Sit outside on the sidewalk tables for the quintessential ‘hidden South Yarra’ experience.
  • Clement Coffee Roasters — 161 Commercial Rd, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Tip: This is the place to go if you are a coffee purist; ask the baristas about their current single-origin rotation.

The Breakfast Club South Yarra

Shop 1/123 Commercial Road, South Yarra VIC 3141

item.title: Best Cafes & Brunch in Southbank 2026
item.description:
description: “18 March 2026 | Food Editor”

Updated 18 March 2026 | Food Editor

Best Cafes & Brunch in Southbank 2026

Southbank’s brunch scene has evolved into a sophisticated affair where riverside views meet Melbourne’s signature coffee culture. Whether you’re recovering from a night at the Arts Centre or fueling up before exploring the Eureka Skydeck, these cafes deliver both quality and convenience.

Venue Addresses & Details

  • Pantry Southbank — 1/109-111 Clarendon St, Southbank VIC 3006 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Tip: Try the corn fritters; they are a local favorite and often sell out by early afternoon.
  • Baseline Cafe — 127-129 Southbank Blvd, Southbank VIC 3006 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM, Sat 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Tip: The house-made almond milk is excellent if you are looking for a dairy-free alternative.
  • Bondi & Bourke — 100 Southbank Blvd, Southbank VIC 3006 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Tip: Grab a seat near the window for great people-watching along the boulevard.
  • Code Black Coffee — 28-30 City Rd, Southbank VIC 3006 ($$). Open: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Tip: Ask the barista for the single-origin filter of the day; they rotate their beans frequently.
  • Freshwater Cafe — 3/3 Southgate Ave, Southbank VIC 3006 ($$). Open: Daily 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM. Tip: Request an outdoor table to enjoy the views of the Yarra River during your meal.

Top Picks for Your Southbank Brunch Adventure

1. The Wharf Hotel

Address: 150 Clarendon St, Southbank VIC 3006
Price Range: $18-28
Must-Try: Corn fritters with poached eggs and smoked salmon
Insider Tip: Book a table by the window for uninterrupted Yarra River views. Their bottomless brunch on weekends is perfect for groups.
